title: Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations: Pricing the Therapeutic Opening Charge
content:
**Business office billing manual — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations, therapeutic opening charge.**

**1. The entry priced.** The therapeutic opening charge prices the therapeutic opening entry, the opening entry of a released Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold that carries more than one resident-private entry: the resident-private entry beginning on the reservation's recorded first privately held day. A reservation carries one resident-private entry per service month, so the therapeutic opening entry is a single entry, its days as booked counted net of any of them reversed against it.

**2. The transfer notice.** A transfer notice counts from the earlier of its latest delivery to the resident and its latest delivery to the representative; where it has been delivered to only one of them, that delivery is the one counted.

**3. Charged days.** The therapeutic opening entry's charged days are its days less any of them held before the transfer notice was delivered, those days being the entry's days dated before the delivery date, or all of its days where no transfer notice is on file.

**4. The daily charge.** The therapeutic opening daily charge is the schedule daily rate for the tier of the room held, the prior schedule pricing the entry's days dated before the current schedule's schedule date and the current schedule the rest. The prior and current schedule rates of each room tier that price the therapeutic opening charge are the figures this schedule restates from the private pay schedule, the current schedule taking effect on its schedule date, 2026-07-01.

| Tier of the room held | Prior schedule daily rate (days dated before 2026-07-01), USD | Current schedule daily rate (2026-07-01 onward), USD |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

The current-schedule days are the calendar days from 2026-07-01 through the entry's last day, never more than the entry's days and none where the entry ends before 2026-07-01; every other day of the entry is a prior-schedule day.

**5. The charge.** The therapeutic opening charge is the therapeutic opening entry's charged days times the therapeutic opening daily charge, rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

**6. Order of combination.** The figures are combined in this order: each schedule rate is first taken to the applicable percent, any per-day credit is then subtracted from that reduced rate, and each resulting daily charge is multiplied by the charged days it applies to; the days not charged at the start of the entry are its first days, the days not charged at the end of the entry are its last days, and the current-schedule days are counted back from the entry's last day; the charge is the sum, rounded half up to the cent once on the total.

**Worked example (hypothetical inputs).** An entry runs from 18 June through 30 June, 13 days, none reversed, for a Private Bariatric Care Room; the earlier of the two latest transfer-notice deliveries is dated 20 June. The 18th and 19th are dated before the delivery date, so 11 days are charged. No day of the entry falls on or after 2026-07-01, so all 11 are prior-schedule days: 11 days at 466.00, a charge of 5,126.00. Had the same entry and notice fallen on 19–31 July instead (the notice dated 21 July), the 11 charged days would all be current-schedule days: 11 days at 482.00, a charge of 5,302.00.
